The '''Thaereian High Command''' was the high command of the [[Thaereian military]]

==History==
The Thaereian High Command was the high command of the [[Thaereian military]], the [[Army/Legends|armed forces]] of the [[Thaereian system]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Xirossk]] of [[Thaereian Intelligence]] was posted by the Thaereian High Command to the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]]. The [[Thaereian]]s secretly operated an arena on the space station in which prisoners were fed to dangerous creatures and Xirossk had orders from the Thaereian High Command to maintain the status quo in regard to the Thaereians' operations on Burnout.<ref name="TAUT" />

{{RPG|''[[Belted In: Incursion|Incursion]]''}}
After the Thaereian [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Lorwin Derlynn]] resigned from the Thaereian military at the behest of the [[heroes of Cularin]] freelance agents, the Thaereian High Command denounced as an "enemy of the state" one of the freelances specifically named in Derlynn's resignation statement. The Thaereian High Command also ruled the individual to be guilty of high crimes against the [[Thaereian Protectorate]] and wanted posters depicting the freelance agent were posted in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Hedrett Public Transport Facility|Hedrett Groundport]] on the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].<ref name="Incursion">{{LivingForce|Belted In: Incursion}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

Around this [[Time/Legends|time]], while passing through the [[Cularin asteroid belt]], several of the crew of the Thaereian customs [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Stark Wing]]'' were possessed by [[Oblee|shadow lurkers]], the incorporeal spirits of the Oblee [[Species/Legends|species]]. Believing the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to be under attack, the crew attacked each other, and the vessel's commander [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jans Tolen]] transferred data on the encounter to the Thaereian High Command before [[Death/Legends|taking]] his own life.<ref name="Excursion">{{LivingForce|Belted In: Excursion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] module ''[[Belted In: Incursion|Incursion]]'' it is possible for the player characters, who roleplay as the heroes of Cularin, to persuade Lorwin Derlynn to defect from the Thaereian military. If this occurs, any players involved significantly in his desertion are denounced by the Thaereian High Command as traitors.<ref name="Incursion" />
